context.transcript:
Good morning, everyone.
Remember how we had been concerned about meeting our monthly sales goal?
Well, the new sweaters have all been sold.
However, now the storage room is a mess and needs to be cleaned up.
We have a lot of empty boxes and packaging in there.
I've updated the duty roster with this assignment.
And speaking of the roster, I know some of you are planning on being away soon for vacation.
Please make sure I have your time-off request forms by the end of the week.
context.transcript_translation:
大家早上好。
还记得我们之前一直担心无法完成每月销售目标吗？
嗯，新款毛衣已经全部售罄了。
不过，现在储藏室一片狼藉，需要清理。
里面有很多空箱子和包装材料。
我已经在值班表上新增了这项任务。
说到值班表，我知道你们中有些人很快要休假。
请务必在本周结束前把休假申请表交给我。
